nom: Paula's Choice SKIN PERFECTING 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including oily T-zones and oily noses, report visibly smaller-looking pores, less midday shine and fewer clogged pores, generally without excess dryness.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are divided: several describe the product as too drying with daily use and cut back to a few times a week with a heavy moisturizer, while others report it left their skin feeling hydrated and plump when paired with a hyaluronic acid serum.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, typically dry cheeks with an oily T-zone, report clearer, less congested pores especially around the nose, achieved gradually with regular use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including some with rosacea, eczema or psoriasis, mostly tolerate the product well at two to three uses a week without burning or breakouts, though a minority report redness or stinging, especially at higher frequency.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late thirties and forties report smoother-looking fine lines and wrinkles alongside clearer skin, though one notes the smoothing effect on wrinkles fades within hours of application.

concerns.aging: Reviewers in their late thirties and forties report fine lines and wrinkles look less pronounced with regular use, and one reports improved texture and radiance; one reviewer notes the wrinkle-smoothing effect is temporary and fades within hours.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers report the product is drying, causing flaking or tightness that requires cutting back frequency or pairing with a rich moisturizer; others, including one with very dry skin, report it left skin hydrated and plump rather than dried out.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin, report no redness or irritation; a minority describe temporary redness, stinging, or a painful pimple forming, particularly with daily use or already irritated skin.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with reactive conditions such as psoriasis or seborrheic dermatitis report the product did not worsen their barrier when used two to three times a week, describing it as smoothing without flaking or burning.
concerns.spots: Reviewers using the product for hyperpigmentation and acne marks report gradual fading with continued use over weeks to a month, though some note existing dark marks or sun spots remained largely unchanged and would need separate treatment.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers report fewer blackheads, clearer pores and calmer cystic or hormonal acne within one to several weeks; a few report the opposite in the early weeks, including enlarged pores, new tiny bumps, or a deep painful pimple, which some attribute to a temporary purging phase.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers with oily skin report less midday shine and visible oil drawn out of pores after use; one reviewer, however, describes the product itself as feeling greasy on application and needing about an hour to dry down before bed.

aspects.libelle: Small amount needed, bottle lasts a long time
Arrives leaking or with a broken seal
Needs a slow introduction; can sting or trigger purging at first

extraits.texte: I really don’t like to post reviews that are negative, but I genuinely just wanna put this out here. Hopefully that’ll help somebody else. This has made my skin much worse. I have been trying to keep up with the purging process, but all it has done for me is make my skin worse. I have all of these tiny little white bumps under my skin that I’ve never had before in my life and I started this three months ago. I’ve been very loyal to it and really just praying that the purging stops but all it’s done is actually made my pores HUGE! I never even had anything on my forehead. Now I do it has not taken away any of my blackheads. I’ve been trying to be super optimistic, but the truth in the reality is is that it’s done absolutely nothing for me and I think it’s finally time that I give it up and throw the bottle out. I really hope that it works for other people. I tried to get excited when I started seeing the little white heads and think oh okay it’s definitely working and maybe it is working, but I’ve seen not a single node to it getting better. It’s disappointing. My skin in the picture is 100 percent due to this product and it’s been like think since I started early February:(

I’ve long suffered from an oily nose together with enlarged pores always filled with ‘gunk’. In the past I’ve tried Biore strips which would lift away some of the clogged pores but was never great. After the first few days I thought Paula’s was the miracle cure. For the first time I saw my nose pores begin to clear and shrink. However after 1.5-2 weeks I could feel a very deep painful pimple forming on tip of my nose. It eventually surfaced and bleeds when I wash my face and this is something I never faced before this product. I’ve discontinued for four days and can now feel another one forming in same area and other area of my nose is irritated and is bleeding. This is an acid, folks. I should have known better. Returning the product to Amazon. Hopefully will not cause scarring.

I’ve been using this product for a few days. My skin is very very sensitive and it does cause some redness so I may not be able to use 2x daily as instructed (or I’ll likely just have to work my way up). It’s disappointing that the instructions for using the product aren’t exactly clear. The first day I used a cotton pad to apply it and the second day I just used my fingers, thus delivering more product to my skin (and more noticeable redness that day). The packaging is interesting because it has a screw cap, then under that there is a flip cap that you use to actually get the product out. Despite these two caps and plastic wrapping, the product still leaked out during shipping, as shown in the photo. I will continue to use it and update after a few weeks of use.

So. I have a compulsive picking disorder, which means I only exacerbate the acne I do have (that’s why it’s so red in the first photo). This said, it’s eliminated a lot of my trouble skin areas; my chin would always have something pop up and I’d make it 10x worse. This product has cleared up a lot of my acne there to begin with and so I have been able to control my bad habits, and it’s really helped with the hyper pigmentation I’ve been experiencing. The ONLY issue I have to say is that, if you already experience issues with dry skin, this is going to be a harsh product for you. It says to use it twice a day, but I found that to be too much. I’d use it right before bed and apply a thick cream on, but still experienced dry skin LIKE CRAZY (I often had to skip a few days to let my skin regain some moisture). Just be sure to test it and not go all the way in with using it twice unless you find that your skin can tolerate it, I happen to be very sensitive to salicylic acid so I can’t use it very often. I’ve been using it for about a month by the way!

extraits.titre: If you actually understand how to use it, it's amazing.
extraits.texte: My skin type: - Very Dry, easily dehydrated - Oily nose - Prone to stubborn acne and closed comedones - Redness on chin and cheeks (not rosacea) I already use a nightly Tretinoin cream (.04% concentration) to help with my acne and premature signs of aging but decided with my derm that incorporating a BHA would be a good idea to help with my seriously stubborn closed comedones and some irritating textural issues. It was between this and the Cerave SA lotion and I ultimately decided on this due to the higher concentration of salicylic acid. It's moisturizing, and feels sticky for the first 5-10 minutes after application but seems to sinks in to something of a satin finish on me and I can no longer feel it on my skin. You just have to be a little patient. My skin feels well hydrated and plump after it settles and looks really smooth and my pores aren't as obvious. It sits just fine under makeup for me but I'm not a new user to chemical exfoliants so I don't have lots of dead skin pilling up or sloughing off when I use it, my skin is, for the most part, already very smooth outside the acne and CCs. Occasionally I'll apply it further down my neck/decolletage than usual and WOW do I old skin just ball up and peel right away - it's so gross but also satisfying. So those that don't exfoliate often or are new to BHA/AHAs will likely have issues with foundation until their skin adjusts (but it will adjust). My advice in those cases is to either use this at night for the first few weeks

extraits.titre: This product works for me and I will be purchasing again!
extraits.texte: This product really helps my skin day to day. I do use it with my regular face wash and I use a vitamin C Serum or aloe (moisturizer) after I put this on. I have definitely seen a difference in my skin since I started using it. There are a lot of people complaining about the size of the bottle, but they also chose to get the one fluid ounce bottle so I don’t know why they were expecting a bigger bottle if it’s only one fluid ounce. They do offer a four fluid ounce bottle which I will be getting my next purchase because I wanted to try the product out before I got a bigger bottle and spent more money than it was worth. But it was definitely worth spending the money on the bigger bottle. Being mindful that all products don’t work for everybody and everyone skin. I do have seborrheic dermatitis on parts of my face, which it has helped tremendously, and I do have very dry and sensitive skin. With that being said, I don’t know about the people who said they have rashes or redness from the product, but I have not experienced any of that. Again everyone’s skin is different, so I do think it is worth taking a chance. Also, it says an exfoliate but it’s not a scrub or anything. It’s a somewhat silky consistency almost like a serum, so be mindful if you were wanting an exfoliating product like a scrub it is not that. I gave it three stars for scent because it doesn’t really smell like anything. I also gave it four stars on moisturizing because like I said, it’s a serum kind of texture,

extraits.titre: Effective but gentle — even with sensitive, psoriasis-prone skin
extraits.texte: I have very sensitive skin and psoriasis, so I have to be extremely careful with exfoliants. Most are either too harsh or trigger irritation. Paula’s Choice 2% BHA Liquid has been surprisingly well-tolerated for me. I use it 2–3 times a week, not daily. That frequency is enough to keep my pores clear, improve texture, and reduce occasional breakouts without compromising my skin barrier. It smooths my skin without causing flaking, burning, or redness — which is rare for an acid product on my skin. If you have sensitive or reactive skin, this isn’t something I’d overuse. Start slow. But used strategically, it’s effective and balanced. For me, it’s one of the few chemical exfoliants that delivers results without triggering a flare. Photos of before and after — black top is before and the blush/pink is a photo after.
